tools.description: Manage SWE mini-agents in isolated Git worktrees. Wait with `mini-swe-mcp watch` in the background and run it again after each event, or the 'watch' action with 'timeout_secs'. You only see or act on your own workers; admin excepted. `mini-swe-mcp help <topic>` covers workflow, watch, steer, review, collect, merge, identity, sandbox, env, consolidate.

action.description: Action to perform; the enum lists every verb.

consolidate.description: Auto-consolidate this owner's group once stopped; true uses strongest/default, string pins model. See help consolidate.

consolidate_verify.description: Full gate for the automatic consolidator; omitted means auto-detect.

diff.description: Diff scope for 'review': 'code' (default) hides tests, 'all' shows everything, 'none' hides it.

group.description: Only workers of this group. For 'watch' and 'merge --approved'.

max_turns.description: Max bash turns (overrides the default); on 'steer', the budget when continuing a stopped worker.

message.description: Correction or follow-up for 'steer', which resumes the worker on its own branch with its full context (optional 'max_turns' sets the budget). Required for 'steer'; also continues a stopped worker: never dispatch a replacement.

model.description:
Available model aliases and their roles:
- `nerd` (id: `combo:nerd`): Deep reasoner. Use for hard debugging, complex architecture, and multi-file refactors.
- `ninja` (id: `combo:ninja`): Fast executor. Use for exploration, test runs, syntax fixes, and focused edits.

network.description: Network: 'offline' isolates every step (no egress); 'allow' (default) keeps connectivity.

review_after.description: Reviewer model (e.g. 'nerd') that audits the worktree after implementation.

task.description: ONE focused concern: files in scope and the acceptance gate.

tasks.description: Batch dispatch: one {task, model?, ...} object per worker; top-level values are defaults.

timeout_secs.description: Deadline in seconds for the blocking 'watch'; on expiry {status:'no_event'}.

verify.description: Optional shell command run before completion is honoured; when omitted, auto-detect one. Pass an empty string to disable the gate. In a consolidated round, give workers the cheap gate.

worker_id.description: Target worker (alias 'id'): a unique 3+ char prefix or 'last'; required for verbs that target one.

worker_ids.description: Worker IDs to watch (same prefixes as 'worker_id'). Omitted watches your own workers.

tools.name: worker
